title: 小野寺元防衛相「武器輸出は『同志国』増やすため」
extracted_text: 政府が防衛装備品の輸出を「救難・輸送・警戒・監視・掃海」に限る「5類型」を撤廃したことは、憲法9条に基づいて日本が掲げる「平和主義」に整合するのか。与党で今回の改定を進めた元実務責任者と、憲法と国の安全保障政策との関係について研究する有識者に話を聞いた。 世界各国は今、一国だけで自国は守れないという現実に直面している。そうした中で日本は協力できる「同志国」を増やしていく必要がある。その一つの手段として、日本の防衛装備や技術の活用で防衛力を強化してもらい、いざというときには同志国とともに抑止力を高めていく。今回の「5類型」撤廃を含む防衛装備移転三原則の改定にはこうした考え方が背景にある。
translated_text: The government's decision to abolish the "five categories" that had limited defense equipment exports to rescue, transport, surveillance, monitoring, and minesweeping operations raises questions about compatibility with the "pacifism" that Japan upholds under Article 9 of the constitution. I spoke with a former senior ruling party figure who spearheaded this revision and with an expert who studies the relationship between the constitution and national security policy. Countries around the world are now confronting the reality that no nation can defend itself alone. In this environment, Japan needs to increase the number of "like-minded countries" it can cooperate with. One way to do this is to have partner nations strengthen their defense capabilities through the use of Japanese defense equipment and technology, so that together they can enhance deterrence when needed. This thinking underlies the revision of the three principles on defense equipment transfers, including the abolition of the "five categories".
title_en: Former Defense Minister Onodera: 'Weapon Exports Aimed at Increasing Like-Minded Countries'
